functional.definition: X (N unit vectors) is a spherical t-design if (1/N) sum_i p(x_i) equals the sphere mean of p for every polynomial p of degree <= t; observed by the max abs residual over monomials x^a y^b z^c, c in {0,1}, a+b+c <= t
functional.sense: maximize strength t at fixed N (zero set of the moment map, a feasibility problem)
functional.critical_point: all harmonic moments of degrees 1..t vanish
functional.gauge: none: coordinates are stored as found; a design is defined up to rotation and reflection
